reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness bridge for discovering verified agent roles, creating role-scoped child Sessions, and optionally attaching them to Agent Team Rooms, making agent orchestration the primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中发现并验证 RoleHub 角色、启动独立的角色会话，并可选地将其附加到 Agent Team Room。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness bridge for discovering and verifying RoleHub roles, starting independent role-scoped Sessions, and optionally attaching them to Agent Team Rooms.

capabilities: Discovers and fetches role catalogs from configured HTTPS hubs
Downloads and verifies role bundles using manifest, archive, and bundle digests
Stores validated role deployments and policy receipts in a private local directory
Creates continuable role-scoped child Sessions in DeepSeek Harness
Optionally attaches created Sessions to Agent Team Rooms
Adds native UI actions, read-only snapshots, and the /rolehub command
